targets.outcome_quote: Across all operationalizations of experience (time since first patient and number of cases treated) and therapy outcome (change in psychopathology, response, remission, and early termination), results largely suggest no association between therapists' experience and therapy outcome.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract states that the original longitudinal U.S. study found experience unrelated to outcomes, and that this replication likewise largely found no association across operationalizations. This is agreement with the original null finding. Target full author list, title and DOI are unavailable in abstract evidence.
